text: The assistant answers real questions well. Two things are still missing before it's trustworthy: sources, and an honest 'I don't know.'
Citations use the source document and chunk id that's been attached to every chunk since lesson eight -- nothing new to compute, just surfaced.
Azure AI Search already scores how good each match is. Below a tuned threshold, the assistant never even calls GPT-4o.
Instead it returns a plain fallback message -- satisfying the no-guessing requirement Priya and Omar locked in back in lesson two.
Next: wrapping this whole pipeline in a real FastAPI service.
